title: About
description: About the artist, and where to find their work.

text: I've decided not to try and explain exactly what is happening here. Doing so can only cause trouble for the work.

**About the shop**
OK TO FAIL does have an [online shop](https://www.oktofail.com) where objects of various sorts will become available. This is how I am able to continue to spend time and resources making this work. I appreciate your continuing support.

The shop is securely hosted by Fourthwall, an industry leader in the creative fulfillment space. All transactions are secure and handled by them directly. I never see your credit card details or any sensitive information.

**Note**
There are all kinds of things in the shop. Some are traditional art objects, some are not. If you see something in my shop, please read the description carefully so you know exactly what you’re looking at because it is not always obvious.

**Privacy Policy**
This website does not collect any data from visitors. Plain and simple. I don’t care about analytics and would rather spend my time making things than spying on people.

My shop is hosted by Fourthwall and they have their own privacy policy as do my social media accounts (Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn). Please refer to the privacy policies on those sites for more details. Of course if you buy something from my shop you agree to disclose certain information so that the transaction can be completed.

There is a sign-up form (below) for my email newsletter which is hosted and managed by beehiiv. If you decide to sign up you will be giving me your email address so that I may send you the newsletter. beehiiv does by default track if newsletters were delivered, opened, etc. As far as I know this cannot be turned off but I won’t ever sell your data or use it for anything other than to deliver the newsletter. I’m just a solitary visual artist, not a data broker.
